title: Halo Dental product showcase
description: Warm stone two-column hardware showcase: a left specification column with a display title, lead paragraph, hairline-divided icon rows, and a vermilion CTA button; a right square media stage with an optional award badge and a three-thumbnail switcher.
notes: uses React state for switching between the three media views; sets hydrate: visible
each slide accepts custom media and thumbnail ReactNodes, defaulting to token-styled studio placeholders
